subject: let user select number digits to show for DT datatable without resetting other customizations

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: let user select number digits to show for DT datatable without resetting other customizations
parts:
Is there a way to let the user specify the number of decimal places to show in a datatable (using DT package) without it resetting other options they've selected? For example, if I use a numericInput so that the user can enter a number of digits, then when using extensions (e.g. ColVis) it will reset all the extensions when the numericInput is changed because the table re-renders.

Thanks a lot,

Jonah

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: let user select number digits to show for DT datatable without resetting other customizations
parts:
Sorry, this is currently not possible, but you can file a feature
request to https://github.com/rstudio/DT/issues Thanks!

Regards,
Yihui
